spacing_rule: No space is permitted between // and notrios; Go otherwise retains the line as ordinary prose.
rules: A declaration doc group has exactly one doc directive and therefore one audience.
Fragment IDs and claim IDs are globally unique, lowercase kebab-case identifiers.
help is valid only with a user fragment and identifies one template slot.
enumerates names a resolvable Go or TS/TSX declaration, never an expression or path/line pair.
claim names an executable repository check; it does not upgrade the grade unless that check exists.
Rationale is an ordinary unmarked comment and is excluded from claim review.
A directive without an attached declaration or a symbol that cannot resolve is an error.
Two audiences in one declaration doc group are an error rather than an ordering convention.

toolchain_finding.comment_text: go/ast.CommentGroup.Text removes recognized directives while CommentGroup.List retains the original comments.
toolchain_finding.parse_directive: go/ast.ParseDirective was added in Go 1.26 and therefore cannot be the G18c implementation while Go 1.25 remains supported.
toolchain_finding.recommendation: Parse CommentGroup.List with a small tested compatibility parser and take prose from CommentGroup.Text; run the fixtures on the minimum and current Go toolchains.
